messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, like, nobody is better
than you at catching bugs,
{07 0b 00}huh?
.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}{07 04 00}WHOA.{01 00 00 05 00} Does that mean
you're the bug-catching
champ?!
{07 0e 00}I think I'm jealous{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}YEP! I'm pretty jealous,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii et, nagu, keegi pole
putukapüügis sinust parem,
{07 0b 00}mis?
{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}{07 04 00}VAU.{01 00 00 05 00} Kas see tähendab,
et sa oled putukapüügi
meister?!
{07 0e 00}Ma vist kadestan sind{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 06 00}JAH! Ma kadestan sind
tõsiselt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You're such a sweetie for
spending time with me and
catching bugs!
{07 00 00}{07 16 00}But you are WAY too good at
it, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 06 00}Don't think I'm gonna forget
that you took my place as
the bug-catching champ!
And there's no way I'm
gonna let you steal my
thunder in other contests!
{07 06 00}I'm trying to become the
princess of all hobbies in
this town, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa oled nii armas, et
veedad minuga aega ja
püüad putukaid!
{07 00 00}{07 16 00}Aga sa oled selles LIIGA
hea, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 06 00}Ära arva, et ma unustan,
et sa võtsid mu koha
putukapüügi meistrina!
Ja ma ei lase sul kuidagi
varastada mu hiilgust
ka teistel võistlustel!
{07 06 00}Ma tahan saada kõigi
selle linna hobide
printsessiks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
